meta.scope: invented independent fixture checks only; not biological validation; no real donor data
semantics: * is an allele absent due to an overlapping deletion; original ALT indexes/GT/PS retained
flanking bases called present on all copies conservatively bound an unknown deletion; exact deletion unsupported
star justified only by overlapping deletion on same phase (or homozygous/haploid); conflicting/orphan stars unsupported
insertion/deletion coordinate paths remain UNPAIRED: never gained/lost by path alone; hit paths crossing no indel stay paired
gained/lost comparable reference locus requires a contiguous reference path and every copy evaluated
a formerly nominated exact reference path is LOST when it fails on every known copy; sequence change is reported at retained nominated loci only
ploidy from hand-declared ploidy_intervals (ploidy_source), never derived from GT alone, sample name or sex
excluded_window_starts: forward start ranges skipped before orientation; excluded windows are never counted as losses
meta.window: 23-base oriented windows = 20nt spacer + NGG, both strands, ungapped <=6 spacer mismatches vs guide

blocks.P: ACGTGACTGACTGACGTACGTGG forward-strand guide hit spacer=guide mm=0
blocks.P2: AAGTTACTGACTGACGTACGTGG forward hit with mm=2 vs guide

cases.description: deletion + star allele with same PS and same phase: star justified, absorbed by deletion on copy1
cases.vcf:
##fileformat=VCFv4.3
##reference=artificial
#CHROM	POS	ID	REF	ALT	QUAL	FILTER	INFO	FORMAT	S1
chrF1	33	.	AACGTGACTGACTGACGTACGTGG	A	.	.	.	GT:PS	1|0:100
chrF1	40	.	C	T,*	.	.	.	GT:PS	2|0:100
expected_facts: ALT indexes retained T=1 *=2
star on copy1 (index39) lies inside the same-PS deleted span 33-55: justified, absorbed by the deletion; c1 carries one P block, c2 carries two
VCF REF strings verified against reference chrF1 numerically

cases.description: multiallelic SNP GT 2|1 breaks the shared PAM anchor on opposite copies (nominated path LOST); separate opposite-copy shared-anchor SNP pair at the retained Q locus

##fileformat=VCFv4.3
##reference=artificial
#CHROM	POS	ID	REF	ALT	QUAL	FILTER	INFO	FORMAT	S1
chrF4	27	.	G	A,C	.	.	.	GT	2|1
chrF4	37	.	G	A	.	.	.	GT	1|0
chrF4	37	.	G	T	.	.	.	GT	0|1
expected_facts: A=1 C=2 indexes retained; copy1 gets C, copy2 gets A at the PAM anchor (pos27) on opposite copies: compatible, not a conflict
CORRECTED: the formerly nominated exact reference P path is LOST because both known sample PAMs fail; it is not a retained sequence change
sequence change is reported at retained nominated loci only: the Q locus is retained on both copies with spacer mm=1 each
separate opposite-copy shared-anchor pair at pos37 (record 2 G>A on copy1, record 3 G>T on copy2) covers the two-overlapping-records subcase

windows overlapping the insertion (after index27) or deletion (indices 54-57) paths remain UNPAIRED; not all chromosome hits are unpaired merely because the chromosome contains an indel
no locus gained/lost by path alone
